summary: Iter51-Publish backend regression PASS. wellknown.py refactor to dynamic os.getenv() is transparent: GET /.well-known/apple-app-site-association and GET /.well-known/assetlinks.json return 200 + application/json with the exact placeholder values (TEAM_ID_TODO / SHA256_FINGERPRINT_TODO_REPLACE_AFTER_BUILD) read from backend/.env. Pytest suite (iter51 unit + iter51 HTTP + iter50 pago-cancha + iter47 deeplink/push) → 66 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failed. Backend boots clean (only a benign bcrypt __about__ warning). Prebuild-check.js emits exactly the 3 expected warnings (IOS_TEAM_ID placeholder, ANDROID_SHA256_FINGERPRINTS placeholder, google-services.json missing + app.config.js detected). app.config.js is valid, loadable via require(), and correctly strips android.googleServicesFile from the exported expo config since only google-services.json.TODO exists. Bonus: the iter50 CRITICAL security bug (decide-request unauthenticated) is now fixed — test_requires_auth_SECURITY_BUG passes without xfail, and test_13b_decidir_403_when_not_organizer passes.

minor.issue: Via the preview K8s ingress the path returns 404 with Expo HTML because the ingress only routes /api/* to backend:8001; /.well-known/* falls through to Expo web on :3000. This is an INFRASTRUCTURE limitation of the preview environment, NOT a code bug. The backend serves both endpoints correctly at localhost:8001 (verified: 200 + application/json + correct payload). In production on padelappretas.app (where FastAPI is fronted by a normal reverse proxy without the /api prefix rule), the routes will work as designed. Iter47 test suite already models this — test_aasa_public_url_returns_non_json is intentionally SKIPPED when not on the production host.
